account.heading: Sign in
account.lead: Sign in with Google to keep your saved charts when you move to another device. Everything else stays in this browser.
account.leadSignedIn: Your saved charts follow this account onto any device you sign in on.
account.unavailable: We cannot reach the account store right now. Nothing in this browser is affected — try again in a moment.
account.storageNote: Your charts, readings and recent birth details are kept in this browser.

signIn.note: Signing in keeps your charts when you switch device. Everything else stays in this browser.
signIn.error_not_configured: Google sign-in isn’t set up on this server yet.
signIn.error_declined: That sign-in was cancelled. If the app is still in testing, the account also has to be on its test-user list.
signIn.error_expired: That attempt took too long. Try again.
signIn.error_state_mismatch: That sign-in couldn’t be verified. Start again from this page.
signIn.error_exchange_failed: Google couldn’t complete the sign-in. Try again.
signIn.error_email_unverified: Google hasn’t verified the email on that account, so it can’t be used to sign in.
signIn.error_signin_failed: Something went wrong finishing sign-in. Try again.

chartSync.askQuestion: Save your charts to your account?
chartSync.askDetail: Your charts are kept in this browser. Saving them to your account means they come back if you clear your history, and they open on your other devices too.
chartSync.askNote: Either way this chart stays on screen and stays in this browser. You can change your mind at any time.
chartSync.decline: Keep them in this browser only
chartSync.nudgeQuestion: This chart lives only in this browser
chartSync.nudgeDetail: Clearing your history erases it, and it will not be on your other devices. Saving it to your account is what makes it come back.
